reference.description: Reference picture for image-to-3D: one centred object on a plain white background, 3/4 view.
reference.positive_suffix: single object, centered, entire object visible, three-quarter front view, plain pure white background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, sharp focus, high detail
reference.negative: multiple objects, cropped, cut off, cluttered background, scenery, text, watermark, logo, harsh shadows, motion blur, blurry, low quality

texture.description: Surface texture: flat, evenly lit, top-down. Seamless tiling is requested but not guaranteed by the current workflow.
texture.positive_suffix: seamless tileable texture, flat top-down orthographic view, uniform diffuse lighting, no shadows, no perspective, no objects, evenly distributed surface detail, high detail
texture.negative: perspective, vanishing point, objects, shadows, vignette, border, frame, text, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality

concept.description: Scene concept art for planning a VR level (scene-kickoff skill): a wide view from human eye height with a readable layout, scale cues and lighting; no people or text.
concept.positive_suffix: environment concept art, wide establishing view from human eye height of about 1.6 m, level camera, clear spatial layout with foreground midground and background, readable scale cues such as doors steps and railings, coherent perspective, realistic materials and lighting, no people, no text
concept.negative: people, characters, crowd, text, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, fisheye, extreme wide-angle distortion, tilted horizon, impossible architecture, blurry, low quality, cartoon

raw.description: Prompt used as written; size and negative prompt come from the workflow.
